metadata.framework_alignment: NIST CSF 2.0 & SANS Incident Handler's Handbook

scoring_logic.1: Manual: Process is explicitly human-led with no evidence of technological automation.
scoring_logic.2: Insufficient Evidence: Documentation confirms the service is provided, but does not verify AI integration.
scoring_logic.3: AI-Augmented: Basic generative AI assistants used for summarization, drafting, or search optimization.
scoring_logic.4: Advanced AI: Specialized models (DSLMs like ForensicLLM) perform deep correlation but require human validation.
scoring_logic.5: Fully Agentic: Autonomous systems that independently plan investigations, execute tools, and document methodology.

ir_focus_type.Core Competency: Pureplay IR consultancies or specialized units where response is the primary work product.
ir_focus_type.Assistance Component: Incident response provided as a feature or support layer within an MDR or SOCaaS contract.

sub_capabilities.name: Visibility Gap Analysis
sub_capabilities.definition: Identifying telemetry blind spots across hybrid environments.

sub_capabilities.name: Behavioral Playbook Design
sub_capabilities.definition: Development of non-linear response logic adapting to attacker tradecraft.

sub_capabilities.name: Tabletop Exercise (TTX) Automation
sub_capabilities.definition: Simulating complex breach scenarios to test personnel, processes, and tools.

sub_capabilities.name: Forensic Readiness Maturity Assessment
sub_capabilities.definition: Benchmarking evidence preservation against ISO 27037 standards.

forensic_investigation.focus: Evidence Identification, Collection, and Analytical Reconstruction

sub_capabilities.name: Triage and Scoping
sub_capabilities.definition: Rapid assessment of incident scope and priority for evidence collection.

sub_capabilities.name: Multi-Hop Timeline Reconstruction
sub_capabilities.definition: Mapping digital events across systems to establish patient zero and the causal backstory.

sub_capabilities.name: Artifact Source Attribution
sub_capabilities.definition: Proving the origin of an artifact by citing the specific file path or system event.

sub_capabilities.name: Malware and Reverse Engineering
sub_capabilities.definition: Technical analysis of malicious code to understand capabilities and persistence.

sub_capabilities.name: Containment and Isolation
sub_capabilities.definition: Rapidly severing attacker access while preserving forensic evidence.

sub_capabilities.name: Root Cause Eradication
sub_capabilities.definition: Closing vulnerabilities and removing persistence mechanisms like backdoors.

sub_capabilities.name: Recovery and Restoration Verification
sub_capabilities.definition: Returning services to operational states while verifying backups are not contaminated.

sub_capabilities.name: Ransomware Negotiation and Outcomes Forecasting
sub_capabilities.definition: Managing settlements and using data to forecast the likelihood of successful recovery.

sub_capabilities.name: Incident Coordination and Escalation
sub_capabilities.definition: Orchestrating response activities across teams and external partners.

sub_capabilities.name: Forensic Quality and Compliance Management
sub_capabilities.definition: Ensuring actions follow SOPs and meet accreditation standards like CREST.

sub_capabilities.name: Crisis and Board Communication
sub_capabilities.definition: Drafting incident summaries and reports that align technical facts with business impact.

sub_capabilities.name: Post-Incident Learning and Review
sub_capabilities.definition: Conducting reviews to identify root causes and improving future posture.

sub_capabilities.name: Evidence Collection and Preservation
sub_capabilities.definition: Maintaining defensible chain of custody from collection through analysis.

sub_capabilities.name: Expert Witness Testimony Support
sub_capabilities.definition: Preparing foundational analysis and reports required for courtroom representation.

sub_capabilities.name: Machine-Inclusive Chain of Custody
sub_capabilities.definition: An unbroken record of handling that meticulously logs human and AI agent interactions.

sub_capabilities.name: Admissibility Defense (Daubert Standard)
sub_capabilities.definition: Ensuring the forensic methodology meets standards for scientific validity.
